title: Housing affordability report — source watch
note: Baselined against the ONS 2025 release used by this report. The workbook fingerprint is the one vendored as data/ons_housing_affordability_2025.xlsx. Re-baseline with `python scripts/check_sources.py --update` only after a new release has been adopted into the report.

sources.label: ONS house price to workplace-based earnings ratio workbook
sources.note: ONS serves the latest edition at the same 'current' address, so a changed fingerprint means a new release. This is byte-identical to the vendored workbook in data/.
